'''''Children of the Jedi''''' is a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] bestselling novel written by [[Barbara Hambly]] and published by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[April]] [[1995]]. The novel is set several months after [[Star Wars: The Jedi Academy Trilogy|''The Jedi Academy Trilogy'']]. It is the first volume of an informal trilogy involving ex–[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Callista Ming]]. The next book in the cycle is [[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']] (1995) by [[Kevin J. Anderson]], followed by ''[[Planet of Twilight]]'' ([[1997]]), also written by Hambly. 

An [[Children of the Jedi (abridged audiobook)|audio version]] narrated by [[Anthony Heald]] was released in 2007.
